page.overview:
Who is Elder Plops?

Elder Plops is shown to have a small white mustache and beard. He also wears a tall and holds a staff, indicating his position of authority. He resembles a traditional Catholic bishop. When seen in "Slime Central ", he's dressed like DJ.
